body:
Hey - sorry been knee deep in Kabocha stuff, just coming back to edgeware. 

Being direct on this, I have exactly the same view on this that I did and still do for the [treasury diversification proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/edgeware/discussion/3809-funding-asset-diversification-proposal_fund-a).

We are diversifying into assets where we have no direct on-chain way of holding said assets and those assets are not related to the growth of our own competencies, network and talent.

If we want to build an investment thesis as a 'decentralised fund', we need to hold assets that are unique to our proposition, not 3rd party chains.

Edgeware is a seed stage investment fund, Kabocha then follows that investment at a growth stage... 

We are building tooling for KAB and EDG that make this decentralised trust fund even more explicit. 



We invest in people and their projects - taking stake in their success, not in projects where there is no connection or relationship.

Hi Zovern,
I am happy to help if needed although there are probably more technical people who might be better candidates.

The only wallet I have is NEAT however.

Hey MoonRocket!  It was a pleasure meeting you and hearing your life perspectives. Thank you for the backing, and I'm glad you're in agreement with the asset selection. I'm here to support our chain in every way I can. 

Also,  could you please let me know which of the wallets you would like to be added to for security ?  In case any of the listed citizens aren't available for the project or possibly,  for redundancy.

I like the proposal, after chatting to Zovern on discord at the pizza party I would personally back this guy.
I like the projects he has picked and think we should give him a shot.
